model_config.normalization: per-volume z-score over nonzero voxels per modality

sampling_details.patient_draws_per_epoch: uniform patient allocation; full training set yields two or three crops per patient
sampling_details.visit_rotation: round-robin through each patient's visits by epoch
sampling_details.lesion_weight: clip(sqrt(median visit lesion volume / lesion volume), 0.5, 2.0)
sampling_details.without_replacement: per visit within epoch until all components have been sampled

model_config.support_mask_definition: largest 26-connected component of the union of nonzero input voxels
model_config.lesion_weight_rule: clip(sqrt(training median lesion volume / lesion volume), 0.5, 2.0), normalized to mean 1 over training positive voxels
